rules: Reuse the source-only quality-filtered and Hungarian-aligned Pattern bank; no additional source collection.
Use only split 0 for training and split 1 for model selection; split 2 is a source-network likelihood audit.
Use the existing cross-source inferred code labels, globally renamed by first occurrence in the inferred consensus. No teacher labels enter generator training.
MADE models the unconstrained 88-position, five-class joint distribution. No top-32 or class-capacity constraint is imposed on AR or frequency proposals.
Uniform proposals use the global training-bank code histogram at every position. Frequency proposals use the per-position histogram with additive smoothing 0.01.
Use fresh observation partitions and numeric seeds, with the same four previously studied held-out patterns. This is a replication, not unseen benchmark tasks.
Numeric settings were selected on source patterns in the earlier v4 protocol; no target-based tuning is performed.
Each method uses 32 starts and 4096 full-support updates per target. VAE+z additionally optimizes latent variables; all other structural proposals are fixed before numeric fitting.
Only query BCE selects checkpoints and starts. Report disjoint test-512 and full-domain-2048 results separately.
Pattern has one shared correct indexator, so this experiment does not establish novel combinatorial transfer.
The inherited extraction assumes four active connections per column and four shared groups of eight; generator receives the resulting bank, not the analytic structure.
Plot training/query losses and recalls against optimizer steps. Do not create or run tests.

Development follow-up to v1: the original bank was selected before tying. Filter indexators using only their source-codebook query BCE <0.3; this cutoff was fixed from source diagnostics, without optimizing target metrics.

Use the same target partitions, initialization seeds and budgets as v1 for a paired comparison. The previous target results have been seen, so v2 is a developmental replication, not a fresh confirmatory test.
The inherited VAE is unchanged and was trained on the earlier unfiltered bank; report this asymmetry explicitly.

bank_filter.criterion: balanced source-query BCE after refitting seven numeric parameters, four starts x 2048 steps; retain original split roles
